system.description:
Invoking the names and powers of the shaper, the sorceress and the trickster, the wizard transmutes his form into that of a sleek falcon. While sustaining Falcon Skin, the caster takes on the stats of the Bird of Prey listed in the Creature Codex PDF download on www.burningwheel.com. He may fly as the bird does, but since he cannot speak or gesticulate, he may not cast spells. For the purposes of The Power Still Flows Through Him rules, use the wizard’s own Forte.

Obstacle: 4. Actions: 12.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Caster | Element: Anima | Impetus: Transmute | Duration: Sustained | Resource Points: 8

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 212
